scope: Effects and RuntimeComposition contracts unchanged. Concrete SQLite, parsing and delivery behavior require executable tests, not only these abstract checks.

crates/coconutclaw-cli/src/delivery/mod..inspection: Only an empty ledger or a known rich plan explicitly ready at zero attempts can be replaced.

crates/coconutclaw-cli/src/delivery/tele.inspection: Durable rejection policy and secondary notices are driven by typed decisions; legacy uncertain policy receipts stay held.

crates/coconutclaw-cli/src/markers.rs.inspection: Compiled outputs carry rejection status; ambiguous legacy display copies supply no effect authority.

crates/coconutclaw-cli/src/recovery/pend.inspection: Pending appends consume saved admission and persist a whole-batch rejection without reading display wording.

crates/coconutclaw-cli/src/scheduler.rs.inspection: Recovery uses recorded admission. Both cancellation materialization and sender reconstruction preserve attempt evidence.

crates/coconutclaw-cli/src/store/migrati.inspection: Nullable admission column leaves existing turns identifiable as legacy; migration does not backfill authority.

crates/coconutclaw-cli/src/store/mod.rs.inspection: Stored turn queries carry optional admission evidence separately from display and provider evidence.

crates/coconutclaw-cli/src/store/turns.r.inspection: Atomic turn insert records admission; all three replay queries decode the same stored decision.

crates/coconutclaw-cli/src/turn.rs.inspection: Live validation records bounded evidence using the decision, not the reply prefix.

crates/coconutclaw-cli/src/types.rs.inspection: Turn resolution explicitly reports parser rejection.

sql/schema.sql.inspection: Nullable admission data on turns, no effects or jobs introduced by schema upgrade.

crates/coconutclaw-cli/src/delivery/medi.inspection: Media and delegated batch validation return a typed rejection with no requested effects.

crates/coconutclaw-cli/src/effect_bounda.inspection: Synthetic SQLite, local provider and mock sender checks separate display, admitted appends and legacy cancellation receipts.
